title: Longkhor Conical Basket Craft
creator: Tangkhul Bamboo Craftsmen
notes: Artisanal hand-woven conical bamboo basket used with head tumpline for transporting paddy, firewood, and harvest produce across mountainous terrain.
indigenous_tangkhul_text: Longkhorli ot phungda kaphungli chat, iram mibingwui pang.
Kahao wui li shaihaida kachak, chanam tara phungda.
Kaphung kongrei luishang kachida, Longkhor mashimanpaishap.
english_translation_text: Carrying loads in the Longkhor basket across mountain trails, the steadfast companion of hill life.
Woven tightly from mature mountain bamboo and cane, defying rain, weight, and wear.
Across every terrace and steep mountain ridge, the Longkhor remains an indispensable tool.
procedural_stages: 1. Harvesting mature mountain bamboo (Kaha) and pliable cane during dry winter months.
2. Splitting bamboo into fine, uniform pliable strips (Lishing).
3. Weaving four-cornered conical base and expanding body with close twill weave.
4. Reinforcing rim with bent hardwood hoop and cane lashing.
5. Attaching woven head tumpline (Khangvai) for ergonomic mountain burden carrying.
seasonal_timing: Year-round agricultural transport and harvest conveyance
